name: imu_calibrate
description: Hands-free Calibrate IMU through the REAL capture screen: the synthetic camera renders a known fixture (stored as a library map) from a near-still viewpoint, the real detector + decoder + PnP register it, and ImuCalFlow takes each pose with no button press when the map registers and everything holds still. A scripted 'user' tilts the fixture to the next pose whenever the screen shows one taken; a fake fixture IMU (consistent with the tilt and a known R_fi) answers get_sensors / set_sensor_mount on the client. After the third pose the flow solves and writes + read-back-verifies the mount; the journey asserts the stored mount is the true R_fi and nothing is left pending. Needs a connected device (the mock is fine).

steps.description: store the synthetic fixture's map, install its fake IMU, open Calibrate IMU
three auto-captured poses -> auto solve -> write -> read-back confirmed
